features: Perfect Fit for Remarkable Paper Pro 11.8" Specially designed for the Remarkable Paper Pro 11.8-inch tablet (2024 release). This remarkable paper pro case fits perfectly and protects your device from dust, scratches, and daily damage. Precise design allows full access to all features while using the remarkable paper pro cover.

Magnetic Attachment Design Built-in strong magnets make it easy to attach and remove your tablet. The magnetic case for remarkable paper pro keeps the tablet secure while writing, reading, or carrying. Slim magnetic design provides quick installation without clips or complicated setup.

Auto Sleep Wake Function The smart remarkable paper pro case supports auto sleep and wake function. When you open the cover, the tablet wakes up, and when you close it, the device goes to sleep to save battery.

Built-in Pen Holder This remarkable paper pro cover with pen holder keeps your stylus safe and always ready to use. The secure pen holder prevents losing the stylus and makes it easy to carry your remarkable tablet case anywhere.

Premium PU Leather Material Made with high quality PU leather exterior and soft microfiber interior. This protective remarkable paper pro case protects the screen from scratches and provides a premium look for your remarkable paper pro tablet.

Slim Lightweight Book Style Design The slim folio remarkable paper pro cover is lightweight and easy to carry. Book style design gives professional style protection while maintaining a thin profile. Perfect for office, school, travel, and daily use.
